en: Color postcard view of a historic Italian piazza on a sunny day. On the left is a red‑stucco Baroque church with a green and yellow tiled dome. In the center stands a row of old palazzi with arcades at street level and green awnings over shopfronts. To the right is a large ornate baroque fountain crowded with statues and water basins, and behind it rises a tall stone medieval clock tower with battlements. People walk around the square and a few 1960s–1970s-era cars are parked along the buildings. Red flowers are visible in the foreground.
